body: Commits d509c67/96cde96 on main. Found via proactive audit. Real bug: a Tyler puppet clone landing the killing blow credited Flow/XP/kills to the clone's own disposable ArenaHero slot, lost the instant that slot gets reused on Tyler's next R -- never reaching Tyler, the real player. New arena_reward_owner() resolves a raw owner index to who should actually be credited, applied at the one call site a clone can ever reach (the flat melee loop; Gary's homing-shot path never sees clones). 1 new test, build clean, full suite green (583/583).
title: Tyler clone kills now credit Tyler, not the disposable clone slot (S170-188)
